big: A headline says the industry's assets hit a record. Does that mean investors earned more? Not at all. Assets can rise because markets rose or because new money came in. Neither tells you what one investor earned.

lines: Assets are at a record. Surely investors are doing well?
AUM is the market value of all holdings on one date. It moves with new money and with prices. It says nothing about what you earned, which depends on what you held and when.

h: AUM falls with no one leaving
note: Prices alone moved the number. Figures are made up for the lesson.

title: Reading AUM
stops: AUM is the market value on a given date
Rising AUM means every investor gained
Net flows and market moves both change AUM
A market fall cannot cut AUM without redemptions
caps: It is a stock, like a snapshot.
Gains depend on what and when each investor bought.
New money and price changes both count.
A price fall alone shrinks AUM.

q: Equity assets of ₹40 lakh crore fall 6% with no redemptions. What happens to AUM?
opts: It stays put at ₹40 lakh crore
It rises by about ₹2.4 lakh crore
It falls by about ₹2.4 lakh crore
It falls by about ₹6 lakh crore
why: Prices fell, so the value of holdings cannot stay put.
A price fall cannot lift the value of what is held.
6% of ₹40 lakh crore is ₹2.4 lakh crore, from prices alone.
₹6 lakh crore is not 6% of ₹40 lakh crore.

q: AUM touches a record high. What can an RM safely say?
opts: Assets are high, but returns vary
Every client has made money this year
The market will keep rising from here
Clients should add more money now
why: AUM shows size, while returns depend on holdings and timing.
AUM says nothing about each client's own gain.
AUM cannot forecast where the market goes next.
Record AUM is not a reason to advise buying.

q: What are the two things that change AUM?
opts: The fund manager's age and fees
The number of ads and launches
Only the new SIP count each month
why: Age and fees are not the drivers of AUM changes.
Ads and launches do not move the figure directly.
SIPs are one flow among several, not the only driver.
New money less redemptions, plus price moves, change AUM.

q: Record SIP inflows arrive in a falling market. What does an RM read from it?
why: Flows cannot tell you where the market bottoms. It does not answer what was asked.
Steady SIPs in a fall show behaviour, which is the useful reading.
Flows do not guarantee any return. The details here point elsewhere.
Many recent investors may still be at a loss. That does not match this case.

pts: AUM is a stock: market value on one date.
It moves with net flows and with prices.
It does not tell you what any one investor earned.
